messages.subject: Problem loading (generating?) control file (yaml)
parts:
Dear group.

Currently, I am trying to run a preliminary analysis with a couple of CC strains (only female mice) we are working with.

I am having a problem when loading the control file (YAML). (please see the Script attached and files I am using to generate the control file).

When I check the read_cross2() I generated, I noticed that the genotype from individuals is not being recognized. I suspect that this error might be caused due to the methods I am sorting the CCs I am working with to generate the geno files, but I am not sure.

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] Problem loading (generating?) control file (yaml)
parts:
I think the yaml file is approximately okay and that your problem is
with the other files.

The cc_crossinfo_KB.csv file has semicolons as delimiters but should use
commas like all of the other files.

What you're doing with map() to subset the genotype files is likely
messing up those files. Subsetting those files to only the strains you
are using is probably not necessary, and so I would start with just
leaving the genotype files intact.

karl
